messages:
customer_jane: Hi team — I accepted the free trial but the $150 credits aren't appearing under our project. Console shows them on a different workspace/org id (org_9x2) but our app uses org_gh4. Can you check?

maya.nguyen: Thanks Jane — can you paste both org IDs (from Console) and the email you used to sign up? That will help us trace the promo grant.

customer_jane: App org: org_gh4, credits-attached org: org_9x2. Email used: jane@acme.com. I didn't create org_9x2 manually.

alex.hernandez: Could be duplicate org created via an alias/SSO. Can you run this and paste the output (mask keys):
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs
```
That lists orgs tied to the key.

customer_jane: Pasted output (masked):
```json
[ {
  "org_id": "org_9x2",
  "display_name": "Acme (old)",
  "credits": "150.00",
  "owner": "jane+git@acme.com"
}, {
  "org_id": "org_gh4",
  "display_name": "Acme",
  "credits": "0.00",
  "owner": "jane@acme.com"
} ]
```

maya.nguyen: Ah — looks like the trial promo was applied to org_9x2 (owner is the alias jane+git@acme.com). We'll escalate to billing to reassign the credit. Creating ticket BILL-1234 and CC'ing billing team.

support-bot: Ticket BILL-1234 created and assigned to billing-team. ETA: 2 business days.

billing_team: Hi Jane — we can transfer the trial credit to org_gh4 once we verify ownership. Please confirm you control both orgs or provide a signed request to billing@redwood.ai.

customer_jane: I confirm I control both. I just emailed billing@redwood.ai with proof (account admin console screenshot).

billing_team: Done — we manually transferred $150.00 from org_9x2 -> org_gh4. Please check your Console and let us know. Ticket BILL-1234 updated.

customer_jane: Verified the $150 credit now shows under org_gh4. Thanks so much! :tada:

alex.hernandez: Root cause: promo grant logic keyed on the email address at time of grant; signing up with an alias/SSO created a separate org and the promo attached there. Action items: (1) billing ticket BILL-1234 completed, (2) add de-dup check in promo pipeline to detect email aliases, (3) add a console warning when multiple orgs share similar owners. Filed follow-up PR and tag BILL-1234-PR. :white_check_mark:
